name: @markbase/browser-agent
comment: Playwright is loaded dynamically at runtime (see src/browser.ts). It is intentionally NOT a hard dependency so the package stays installable everywhere; the one-click unsubscribe path needs no browser, and the browser-driven path degrades to a manual link when Playwright/Chromium isn't present. To enable the live browser agent: `npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium`.
